name: Xray
author: grigabyte
description: VPN client in the bar on the Xray core: subscriptions with VLESS (REALITY, XHTTP), Trojan, Shadowsocks, VMess and Hysteria2 links or xray JSON profiles, a system-wide TUN, an nftables killswitch, split DNS, per-site rules, site checks (does a site open and which way it goes), an optional fallback node, desktop notifications and xray core updates with pinned checksums. Installs its xray-omarchy backend package on first use (asks first).

barWidget.description: The Xray tunnel in the bar: turn it on and off, pick a node by delay, switch subscriptions, see traffic through the tunnel and direct, the killswitch, DNS and where sites went.
